description: Scan a Markdown document's ATX headings (# through ######) and build a nested table of contents with GitHub-style anchor slugs, disambiguating duplicate headings with -1, -2, ... suffixes. Setext-style headings are not recognized, and headings inside fenced code blocks are ignored.

markdown.description: The Markdown document to scan for headings

maxLevel.description: Deepest heading level to include, defaults to 6

minLevel.description: Shallowest heading level to include, defaults to 1

ordered.description: Render as a numbered list instead of a bullet list, defaults to false

name: generate_markdown_toc
